claims.scope: Universal informal component proof at only the guarded boundary 2k=N+2, N=2m. No actual first descent, eligibility, current-p strict selector, original-tag selected sum, other rank, mixed profile, MASS, or primary payment conclusion.
claims.reason: Palindromic log-concavity gives Q[m]>=Q[m-1]>0; exact substitution yields a numerator 3Q[m]+(m-1)(Q[m]-Q[m-1])>0 over positive m+1. Independent monomial checks cover m=1..12 as corroboration.
